info.description: Construction Partners, Inc. is a civil infrastructure company, which engages in the construction and maintenance of roadways and highways. The firm is also involved in the provision of products and services to both public and private infrastructure projects, with an emphasis on highways, roads, bridges, airports, and commercial and residential developments. The company was founded by Ned N. Fleming, III, R. Alan Palmer, and Charles E. Owens in 1999 and is headquartered in Dothan, AL.
info.description_zh: Construction Partners, Inc. 是一家民用基礎設施公司，從事道路和高速公路的建設和維護。該公司還為公共和私人基礎設施項目提供產品和服務，重點是高速公路、道路、橋樑、機場以及商業和住宅開發項目。該公司由 Ned N. Fleming, III、R. Alan Palmer 和 Charles E. Owens 於 1999 年創立，總部位於阿拉巴馬州多森。

info.description: Pinnacle West Capital Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of energy and related products. It offers regulated retail and wholesale electricity businesses and related activities, such as generation, transmission, and distribution through its subsidiary, Arizona Public Service Co. The company was founded on February 20, 1985, and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: Pinnacle West Capital Corp. 是一家控股公司，從事提供能源及相關產品業務。它透過其子公司亞利桑那公共服務公司提供受監管的零售和批發電力業務及相關活動，例如發電、輸電和配電。該公司成立於 1985 年 2 月 20 日，總部位於亞利桑那州鳳凰城。

info.description: Celldex Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the business of development, manufacturing and commercialization of novel therapeutics for human health care. Its drug candidates have the ability to engage the human immune system and directly inhibit tumors to treat specific types of cancer and other diseases. Its pipeline includes Varlilumab, CDX-1140, and CDX-301, and CDX-3379. The company was founded by Anthony S. Marucci and Tibor Keler in 1983 and is headquartered in Hampton, NJ.
info.description_zh: Celldex Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the business of development, manufacturing and commercialization of novel therapeutics for human health care. Its drug candidates have the ability to engage the human immune system and directly in speccess have the ability to engage the human immune system and directly in species soo diseases.其管道包括 Varlilumab、CDX-1140、CDX-301 和 CDX-3379。该公司由 Anthony S. Marucci 和 Tibor Keler 于 1983 年创立，总部位于新泽西州汉普顿。

info.description: Exelon Corp. is a utility services holding company, which engages in energy distribution and transmission businesses. It operates through the following segments: Commonwealth Edison Company (ComEd), PECO Energy Company (PECO), Baltimore Gas and Electric Company (BGE), Potomac Electric Power Company (Pepco), Delmarva Power and Light Company (DPL), and Atlantic City Electric Company (ACE). The company was founded on February 4, 1999 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: Exelon Corp.是一家公用事業服務控股公司，從事能源分配和傳輸業務。該公司透過以下部門營運：聯邦愛迪生公司 (ComEd)、PECO 能源公司 (PECO)、巴爾的摩天然氣和電力公司 (BGE)、波托馬克電力公司 (Pepco)、德爾馬瓦電力和照明公司 (DPL) 以及大西洋城電力公司 (ACE)。該公司成立於1999年2月4日，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: American Electric Power Co., Inc. engages in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity. It operates through the following segments: Vertically Integrated Utilities, Transmission and Distribution Utilities, AEP Transmission Holdco, and Generation and Marketing. The Vertically Integrated Utilities segment covers the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity for sale to retail and wholesale customers. The Transmission and Distribution Utilities segment represents the transmission and distribution of electricity for sale to retail and wholesale customers. The AEP Transmission Holdco segment comprised of the development, construction, and operation of transmission facilities through investments in its wholly-owned transmission subsidiaries and joint ventures. The Generation and Marketing segment consists of the non-regulated generation and marketing, risk management, and retail activities. The company was founded on December 20, 1906 and is headquartered in Columbus, OH.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: 美國電力公司從事發電、輸電和配電業務。它透過以下部門運作：垂直一體化公用事業部門、輸電和配電公用事業部門、AEP 傳輸控股公司以及發電和行銷部門。垂直一體化公用事業部門涵蓋向零售和批發客戶銷售電力的發電、輸電和配電。輸配電公用事業部門負責向零售和批發客戶銷售電力的輸配電業務。 AEP Transmission Holdco 部門透過投資其全資輸電子公司和合資企業來開發、建造和營運輸電設施。發電和行銷部門包括不受監管的發電和行銷、風險管理和零售活動。該公司成立於 1906 年 12 月 20 日，總部位於俄亥俄州哥倫布市。

info.description: Arch Capital Group Ltd. engages in the provision of property and casualty insurance and reinsurance lines. It operates through the following segments: Insurance, Reinsurance, Mortgage, Corporate, and Other. The Insurance segment consists of insurance underwriting units which offer specialty product lines like construction and national accounts, excess and surplus casualty, lenders products, professional lines, and programs. The Reinsurance segment is composed of reinsurance underwriting which offers specialty product lines such as casualty, marine and aviation, other specialty, property catastrophe, property excluding property catastrophe, and other. The Mortgage segment includes U.S. and international mortgage insurance and reinsurance operations as well as GSE credit risk sharing transactions. The Corporate segment represents net investment income, other income, corporate expense, interest expense, net realized gains and losses, and net impairment losses. The Other segment refers to Watford Re. which is a variable interest entity. The company was founded by Clements Robert in March 1995 and is headquartered in Hamilton, Bermuda.
info.description_zh: Arch Capital Group Ltd. 從事提供財產和傷亡保險以及再保險業務。它透過以下部門運作：保險部門、再保險部門、抵押貸款部門、企業部門和其他部門。保險部門由保險承保單位組成，提供專業產品線，如建築和國民帳戶、超額和盈餘傷亡、貸方產品、專業產品線和計劃。再保險部門由再保險承保組成，提供專業產品線，如傷亡、海事和航空、其他專業、財產巨災、不包括財產巨災的財產等。抵押貸款部門包括美國和國際抵押貸款保險和再保險業務以及 GSE 信用風險分擔交易。公司部門代表淨投資收入、其他收入、公司費用、利息費用、已實現淨收益和損失以及淨減值損失。其他部分是指沃特福德再保險。這是一個可變利益實體。該公司由 Clements Robert 於 1995 年 3 月創立，總部位於百慕達漢密爾頓。

info.description: CMS Energy Corp. engages in the provision of electric and natural gas activities. It operates through the following business segments: Electric Utility, Gas Utility, and NorthStar Clean Energy. The Electric Utility segment focuses on generation, purchase, distribution, and sale of electricity. The Gas Utility segment includes purchase, transmission, storage, distribution, and sale of natural gas. The NorthStar Clean Energy segment is involved in domestic independent power production including the development and operation of renewable generation and the marketing of independent power production. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Jackson, MI.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: CMS Energy Corp. 從事提供電力和天然氣活動。它透過以下業務部門運作：電力部門、燃氣部門和北極星清潔能源部門。電力公用事業部門專注於發電、購買、分配和銷售電力。燃氣公用事業部門包括天然氣的購買、輸送、儲存、分配和銷售。北極星清潔能源部門從事國內獨立電力生產，包括再生能源發電的開發和運營以及獨立電力生產的營銷。該公司成立於 1987 年，總部位於密西根州傑克遜。

info.description: Entergy Corp. is a holding company, which engages in providing electric and natural gas services. It operates through the Utility, and Parent and Other segments. The Utility segment includes the generation, transmission, distribution, and sale of electric power in portions of Arkansas, Mississippi, Texas, and Louisiana. The Parent and Other segment refers to the parent company, Entergy Corporation, and other business activities. The company was founded by Harvey Couch on November 13, 1913 and is headquartered in New Orleans, LA.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: Entergy Corp. 是一家控股公司，從事提供電力和天然氣服務。它透過公用事業、母公司和其他部門運作。公用事業部門包括阿肯色州、密西西比州、德克薩斯州和路易斯安那州部分地區的電力生產、輸電、配電和銷售。母公司和其他部門是指母公司 Entergy Corporation 和其他業務活動。該公司由 Harvey Couch 於 1913 年 11 月 13 日創立，總部位於路易斯安那州新奧爾良。

info.description: Loews Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the business of commercial property and casualty insurance, transportation and storage of natural gas and natural gas liquids, and operation of a chain of hotels. It operates through the following segments: CNA Financial, Boardwalk Pipelines, Loews Hotels and Co, and Corporate. The CNA Financial segment is involved in the sale of property and casualty insurance products and services, including surety, primarily through a network of independent agents, brokers, and managing general underwriters. The Boardwalk Pipelines segment focuses on midstream portion of the natural gas and NGLs industry, providing transportation, and storage for those commodities. The Loews Hotels and Co segment refers to a chain of hotels, which are in the United States and one of which is in Canada. The Corporate segment consists of investment income from the parent company's cash and investments, parent company interest expense, and other unallocated parent company expenses. The company was founded by Laurence A. Tisch and Preston Robert Tisch on November 12, 1969 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: Loews Corp.是一家控股公司，從事商業財產和傷亡保險、天然氣和天然氣液體運輸和儲存以及連鎖飯店經營業務。該公司透過以下部門營運：CNA Financial、Boardwalk Pipelines、Loews Hotels and Co 和 Corporate。 CNA Financial 部門主要透過獨立代理人、經紀人和管理總承保人組成的網絡，從事財產和意外保險產品和服務的銷售，包括保證。 Boardwalk Pipelines 部門專注於天然氣和液化天然氣行業的中游部分，為這些商品提供運輸和儲存。 Loews Hotels and Co 部門是指一家連鎖飯店，其位於美國，其中一家位於加拿大。公司部門包括母公司現金和投資的投資收入、母公司利息支出以及其他未分配的母公司支出。該公司由 Laurence A. Tisch 和 Preston Robert Tisch 於 1969 年 11 月 12 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Alliant Energy Corp. engages in the provision of regulated electricity and natural gas service to natural gas customers in the Midwest through its two public utility subsidiaries. It operates through the Utility and ATC Holdings, Non-Utility, Parent, and Other segments. The Utility segment includes the operations of IPL and WPL, which primarily serve retail customers in Iowa and Wisconsin. The ATC Holdings, Non-Utility, Parent, and Other segment refers to the operations of AEF and its subsidiaries, Corporate Services, the Alliant Energy parent company, and any Alliant Energy parent company consolidating adjustments. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Madison, WI.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: Alliant Energy Corp. 透過其兩家公用事業子公司向中西部的天然氣客戶提供受監管的電力和天然氣服務。它透過公用事業和 ATC Holdings、非公用事業、母公司和其他部門進行運作。公用事業部門包括 IPL 和 WPL 的業務，主要為愛荷華州和威斯康辛州的零售客戶提供服務。 ATC Holdings、非公用事業、母公司和其他部門是指 AEF 及其子公司、企業服務、Alliant Energy 母公司以及任何 Alliant Energy 母公司合併調整的業務。該公司成立於 1981 年，總部位於威斯康辛州麥迪遜。

info.description: Aldabra 4 Liquidity Opportunity Vehicle, Inc. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 24, 2025 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Aldabra 4 Liquidity Opportunity Vehicle, Inc. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月24日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: AMERISAFE, Inc. engages in the provision of workers' compensation insurance focused on small to mid-sized employees. The firm covers the construction, trucking, logging and lumber, agriculture, manufacturing, telecommunications, and maritime industries. The company was founded by Millard E. Morris on October 28, 1985 and is headquartered in DeRidder, LA.
info.description_zh: AMERISAFE, Inc. 致力於提供中小型員工的工傷賠償保險。該公司業務涵蓋建築、卡車運輸、伐木和木材、農業、製造、電信和海運行業。該公司由 Millard E. Morris 於 1985 年 10 月 28 日創立，總部位於路易斯安那州德里德。

info.description: Tema Oncology ETF seeks to provide long-term growth. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets, which include borrowings for investment purposes, in publicly listed companies that derive at least 50% of revenues from oncology. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tema Oncology ETF 尋求提供長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金尋求透過將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於至少50%收入來自腫瘤學的上市公司來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Maplebear, Inc. engages in the design and development of an online application that offers grocery delivery and pick-up services. The firm offers Instacart which enables users to connect with personal shoppers in the area who pick up and deliver groceries from local stores. The company was founded by Apoorva Mehta, Brandon Leonardo, and Max Mullen in 2012 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Maplebear, Inc. 從事設計和開發提供雜貨配送和提貨服務的線上應用程式。該公司提供 Instacart，使用戶能夠與該地區從當地商店提貨和送貨的個人購物者聯繫。該公司由 Apoorva Mehta、Brandon Leonardo 和 Max Mullen 於 2012 年創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Enanta Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery and development of small molecule drugs for the treatment of viral infections and liver diseases. It produces clinical candidates which targets respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) diseases. The firm also conducts research in human metapneumovirus (hMPV) and SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19). The company was founded by Peter O. Kliem Martin Karplus, James Hogle, Gerard Wagner, Peter M. Howley, and Gregory L. Verdine in 1995 and is headquartered in Watertown, MA.
info.description_zh: Enanta Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家生物技術公司，致力於發現和開發用於治療病毒感染和肝臟疾病的小分子藥物。它生產針對呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）、乙型肝炎病毒（HBV）和非酒精性脂肪性肝炎（NASH）疾病的臨床候選藥物。該公司也進行人類偏肺病毒 (hMPV) 和 SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) 的研究。該公司由 Peter O. Kliem Martin Karplus、James Hogle、Gerard Wagner、Peter M. Howley 和 Gregory L. Verdine 於 1995 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃特敦。

info.description: Monte Rosa Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a biotechnology company, which engages in the developing of precision medicines. The company was founded on November 21, 2019 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Monte Rosa Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家生物技術公司，致力於精準藥物的開發。該公司成立於2019年11月21日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Cybin, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company on a mission to create safe and effective psychedelic-based therapeutics to address the large unmet need for new and innovative treatment options for people who suffer from mental health conditions. It is currently developing CYB003, a proprietary deuterated psilocybin analog for the treatment of major depressive disorder and CYB004, a proprietary deuterated DMT molecule for generalized anxiety disorder and has a research pipeline of investigational psychedelic-based compounds. The company was founded by Paul Glavine, Eric So, and John Kanakis on October 13, 2016 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Cybin, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，其使命是創造安全有效的迷幻療法，以滿足精神健康問題患者對新型創新治療方案的巨大未滿足需求。該公司目前正在開發 CYB003（一種用於治療重度憂鬱症的專有氘代裸蓋菇素類似物）和 CYB004（一種用於治療廣泛性焦慮症的專有氘代 DMT 分子），並擁有一系列基於致幻劑的研究化合物的研究管線。該公司由 Paul Glavine、Eric So 和 John Kanakis 於 2016 年 10 月 13 日創立，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Tema Cardiovascular and Metabolic ETF seeks to provide long-term growth of capital. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets, which include borrowings for investment purposes, in publicly listed companies that derive at least 50% of revenues from products or services related to the treatment of cardiovascular diseases and/or metabolic diseases, as defined by the Centers for Diseases Control and Preventions. The fund advisor generally is expected to consist of more than 15 companies but not more than 100 companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tema 心血管和代謝 ETF 尋求提供長期資本成長。在正常情況下，該基金尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於至少 50% 收入來自與疾病控制和預防中心定義的心血管疾病和/或代謝疾病治療相關的產品或服務的上市公司來實現其投資目標。基金顧問一般預計由超過15家公司組成，但不超過100家公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Innoviva, Inc. engages in the development, commercialization, and financial management of biopharmaceuticals. Its portfolio includes Relvar Breo Ellipta, which is a once-daily combination medicine consisting of a long-acting beta2 agonist, vilanterol, and an inhaled corticosteroid, fluticasone furoate, and Anoro Ellipta, a once-daily medicine combining a long-acting muscarinic antagonist, umeclidinium bromide, LABA, VI. The company was founded by P. Roy Vagelos, Mathai Mammen, and George M. Whitesides in November 1996 and is headquartered in Burlingame, CA.
info.description_zh: Innoviva, Inc. 從事生物製藥的開發、商業化和財務管理。其產品組合包括 Relvar Breo Ellipta（一種每日一次的複方藥物，由長效 β2 激動劑維蘭特羅和吸入性皮質類固醇糠酸氟替卡松組成）和 Anoro Ellipta（一種每日一次的複方藥物，由長效毒蕈鹼拮抗劑、umeclidinium bromide、LABA, VI 組成）。該公司由 P. Roy Vagelos、Mathai Mammen 和 George M. Whitesides 於 1996 年 11 月創立，總部位於加州伯林格姆。

info.description: Jade Biosciences, Inc. is a biotechnology company which engages in the development of drugs for rare cardiopulmonary disease. It focuses on advancing AV-101, a dry powder inhaled formulation of imatinib for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension. The company was founded by Benjamin T. Dake on July 27, 2018 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Jade Biosciences, Inc.是一家生物技術公司，從事罕見心肺疾病藥物的開發。該公司專注於開發 AV-101，這是一種用於治療肺動脈高壓的伊馬替尼乾粉吸入製劑。該公司由 Benjamin T. Dake 於 2018 年 7 月 27 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Kazia Therapeutics Ltd. is an oncology-focused biotechnology company, which engages in the business of pharmaceutical drug development. It focuses on its Paxalisib program, which is designed to treat brain cancer. The company was founded by Graham Edmund Kelly in March 1994 and is headquartered in Sydney, Australia.
info.description_zh: Kazia Therapeutics Ltd.是一家專注於腫瘤學的生物技術公司，從事藥物開發業務。它專注於其旨在治療腦癌的 Paxalisib 計畫。該公司由 Graham Edmund Kelly 於 1994 年 3 月創立，總部位於澳洲雪梨。

info.description: Liberty Latin America Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of fixed, mobile, and subsea telecommunications services. It operates through the following segments: C and W Carribean, C and W Panama, Liberty Networks, Liberty Puerto Rico, Liberty Costa Rica, and VTR. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: Liberty Latin America Ltd. 是一家控股公司，提供固定、移動和海底電信服務。該公司透過以下部門營運：C and W Carribean、C and W Panama、Liberty Networks、Liberty Puerto Rico、Liberty Costa Rica 和 VTR。該公司成立於 1999 年，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: Liberty Latin America Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of fixed, mobile, and subsea telecommunications services. It operates through the following segments: C and W Carribean, C and W Panama, Liberty Networks, Liberty Puerto Rico, Liberty Costa Rica, and VTR. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: Liberty Latin America Ltd. 是一家控股公司，提供固定、移動和海底電信服務。該公司透過以下部門營運：C and W Carribean、C and W Panama、Liberty Networks、Liberty Puerto Rico、Liberty Costa Rica 和 VTR。該公司成立於 1999 年，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: Lipocine, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the research and development of the delivery of drugs using proprietary delivery technology. It offers TLANDO, an oral testosterone replacement therapy. The company was founded on October 13, 2011 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Lipocine, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，利用專有的遞送技術從事藥物遞送的研究和開發。它提供 TLANDO，一種口服睾酮替代療法。該公司成立於2011年10月13日，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: NewtekOne, Inc. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of business and financial solutions. Its brands include Newtek Bank, Newtek Lending, Newtek Payments, Newtek Insurance, Newtek Payroll, and Newtek Technology. The company was founded by Barry Sloane in 1998 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: NewtekOne, Inc.是一家金融控股公司，從事提供業務和金融解決方案。其品牌包括 Newtek Bank、Newtek Lending、Newtek Payments、Newtek Insurance、Newtek Payroll 和 Newtek Technology。該公司由 Barry Sloane 於 1998 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Nektar Therapeutics is a biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery and development of novel therapies which selectively modulate the immune system to treat autoimmune disorders. It also focuses on immunology and unparalleled expertise in polymer chemistry to create one-of-a-kind, highly-selective medicines with optimal therapeutic benefit. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Nektar Therapeutics 是一家生物技術公司，致力於發現和開發選擇性調節免疫系統以治療自體免疫疾病的新型療法。它還專注於免疫學和高分子化學方面無與倫比的專業知識，以創造一種具有最佳治療效果的獨一無二的、高度選擇性的藥物。該公司成立於 1990 年，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: NMI Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of private mortgage guaranty insurance. It focuses on long-term customer relationships, disciplined and proactive risk selection and pricing, fair and transparent claims of payment practices, responsive customer service, financial strength, and profitability. The company was founded on May 19, 2011 and is headquartered in Emeryville, CA.
info.description_zh: NMI Holdings, Inc. 從事提供私人抵押擔保保險業務。它注重長期的客戶關係、嚴格和主動的風險選擇和定價、公平和透明的付款實踐索賠、快速回應的客戶服務、財務實力和盈利能力。該公司成立於2011年5月19日，總部位於加州埃默里維爾。

info.description: Oportun Financial Corp. is a mission-driven financial services company, which engages in the financial goals within reach with intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Its products include personal loans, secured personal loans, credit cards, savings, direct, and investment and retirement. The company was founded in August 2005 and is headquartered in San Mateo, CA.
info.description_zh: Oportun Financial Corp. 是一家以使命為導向的金融服務公司，透過智慧借貸、儲蓄和預算能力實現可實現的財務目標，讓會員有信心建立更美好的財務未來。其產品包括個人貸款、擔保個人貸款、信用卡、儲蓄、直接貸款、投資和退休。該公司成立於 2005 年 8 月，總部位於加州聖馬刁。

info.description: Palomar Holdings, Inc. is a specialty insurance company, which engages in the provision of property and casualty insurance products to individuals and businesses. The firm focuses on the residential and commercial earthquake markets in earthquake-exposed states such as California, Oregon, and Washington and states with exposure to the New Madrid Seismic Zone. It offers property and casualty insurance. The company was founded by Armstrong Mac and Fisher Heath in February 2014 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: Palomar Holdings, Inc.是一家專業保險公司，致力於向個人和企業提供財產和傷亡保險產品。該公司專注於加州、俄勒岡州和華盛頓州等地震地區以及新馬德里地震帶地區的住宅和商業地震市場。它提供財產和傷亡保險。該公司由 Armstrong Mac 和 Fisher Heath 於 2014 年 2 月創立，總部位於加州拉霍亞。

info.description: ProQR Therapeutics NV is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of RNA therapies for the treatment of severe genetic rare diseases with a focus on inherited retinal diseases. The company was founded by Daniel Anton de Boer, Gerard J. Platenburg, Henri A. Termeer, and Domenico Valerio on February 21, 2012, and is headquartered in Leiden, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: ProQR Therapeutics NV 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發 RNA 療法，用於治療嚴重的遺傳性罕見疾病，重點是遺傳性視網膜疾病。該公司由 Daniel Anton de Boer、Gerard J. Platenburg、Henri A. Termeer 和 Domenico Valerio 於 2012 年 2 月 21 日創立，總部位於荷蘭萊頓。

info.description: Ribbon Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 17, 2024 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
info.description_zh: Ribbon Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年7月17日，總部位於日本東京。

info.description: Summit State Bank engages in providing an array of financial services to small and medium-sized businesses, their owners and employees, entrepreneurs, high net worth families, foundations, estates, and individual consumers. It specializes in business services, personal accounts, nonprofit programs, and mobile banking ranging from lending, checking, merchant, eBanking, automated teller machines, equity loans, and others. The company was founded on December 20, 1982 and is headquartered in Santa Rosa, CA.
info.description_zh: Summit State Bank 致力於為中小型企業、其所有者和員工、企業家、高淨值家庭、基金會、遺產和個人消費者提供一系列金融服務。它專門從事商業服務、個人帳戶、非營利計劃和行動銀行業務，範圍包括貸款、支票、商業、電子銀行、自動櫃員機、股權貸款等。該公司成立於1982年12月20日，總部位於加州聖羅莎。

info.description: Theravance Biopharma, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, research, development, and commercialization of respiratory medicines. It operates through the following geographical segments: U.S. and Europe. The company was founded in July 2013 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Theravance Biopharma, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，從事呼吸系統藥物的發現、研究、開發和商業化。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國和歐洲。該公司成立於2013年7月，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Tenax Therapeutics, Inc. is a pharmaceutical company engaged in the development and commercialization of products for cardiovascular and pulmonary diseases. The company was founded on May 26, 1967 and is headquartered in Chapel Hill, NC.
info.description_zh: Tenax Therapeutics, Inc.是一家從事心血管和肺部疾病產品的開發和商業化的製藥公司。該公司成立於 1967 年 5 月 26 日，總部位於北卡羅來納州教堂山。

info.description: Taysha Gene Therapies, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development and commercialization of adeno-associated viruses (AAV) based gene therapies for the treatment of monogenic diseases of the central nervous system. It also develops multiple gene therapy platforms which include AAV9 Discovery, Novel Capsid, and AAV Redosing. The company was founded by Steven Gray, Berge Minassian, and R. A. Session II in 2019 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Taysha Gene Therapies, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於基於腺相關病毒（AAV）的基因療法的開發和商業化，用於治療中樞神經系統的單基因疾病。它還開發了多種基因治療平台，包括 AAV9 Discovery、Novel Capsid 和 AAV Redosing。該公司由 Steven Gray、Berge Minassian 和 R. A. Session II 於 2019 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: Union Bankshares, Inc. is a one-bank holding company for Union Bank, which engages in the provision of retail, commercial, municipal banking, and wealth management and trust services. It offers residential real estate loans, construction real estate loans, commercial real estate loans, commercial loans, consumer loans, and municipal loans. The company was founded in 1891 and is headquartered in Morrisville, VT.
info.description_zh: Union Bankshares, Inc. 是聯合銀行的單一銀行控股公司，從事提供零售、商業、市政銀行以及財富管理和信託服務。它提供住宅房地產貸款、建築房地產貸款、商業房地產貸款、商業貸款、消費貸款和市政貸款。該公司成立於 1891 年，總部位於佛蒙特州莫里斯維爾。

info.description: USCB Financial Holdings, Inc. engages in banking activities. It offers lending services, credit practices, deposit products, title services, and other banking related services. The company was founded on December 17, 2021 and is headquartered in Doral, FL.
info.description_zh: USCB Financial Holdings, Inc. 從事銀行活動。它提供貸款服務、信貸業務、存款產品、產權服務和其他銀行相關服務。該公司成立於2021年12月17日，總部位於佛羅裡達州多拉。

info.description: Western New England Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It offers a range of investment advisory and wealth management services. Its loan portfolio includes commercial real estate, residential real estate, commercial and industrial, and consumer loans. The company was founded in 1853 and is headquartered in Westfield, MA.
info.description_zh: Western New England Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，提供金融服務。它提供一系列投資諮詢和財富管理服務。其貸款組合包括商業房地產、住宅房地產、商業和工業貸款以及消費貸款。該公司成立於 1853 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州韋斯特菲爾德。

info.description: ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a bio-pharmaceutical company, which engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of branded and generic prescription pharmaceuticals. It operates through the Generics, Established Brands, and Other, and Rare Disease segments. The Generics, Established Brands, and Other segment consists of contract manufactured products, development services, royalties, and other. The Rare Disease segment involves the operations related to Cortrophin Gel. The company was founded on August 29, 1996 and is headquartered in Baudette, MN.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，從事品牌和仿製藥處方藥的開發、製造和行銷。它透過仿製藥、知名品牌、其他和罕見疾病部門運作。仿製藥、知名品牌和其他部門包括合約製造產品、開發服務、特許權使用費等。罕見疾病部門涉及與 Cortropin 凝膠相關的業務。該公司成立於 1996 年 8 月 29 日，總部位於明尼蘇達州 Baudette。

info.description: RTX Corp. is an aerospace and defense company, which engages in the provision of aerospace and defense systems and services for commercial, military, and government customers. It operates through the following segments: Collins Aerospace Systems (Collins), Pratt and Whitney, Raytheon Intelligence and Space (RIS), and Raytheon Missiles and Defense (RMD). The Collins segment manufactures and sells aero structures, avionics, interiors, mechanical systems, mission systems, and power controls. The Pratt and Whitney segment includes the design and manufacture of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems for commercial, military, and business aircraft. The RIS segment is involved in the development of sensors, training, and cyber and software solutions. The RMD segment offers end-to-end solutions to detect, track, and engage threats. The company was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Arlington, VA.
info.description_zh: RTX Corp. 是一家航空航太和國防公司，致力於為商業、軍事和政府客戶提供航空航太和國防系統及服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：柯林斯航空航天系統公司（Collins）、普惠公司、雷神情報與航太公司（RIS）以及雷神飛彈與防禦公司（RMD）。柯林斯部門製造和銷售航空結構、航空電子設備、內裝、機械系統、任務系統和動力控制。普惠部門包括設計和製造商用、軍用和公務飛機的飛機引擎和輔助動力系統。 RIS 部門涉及感測器、培訓以及網路和軟體解決方案的開發。 RMD 部門提供端到端解決方案來偵測、追蹤和應對威脅。該公司成立於 1922 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿靈頓。

info.description: Astoria Dynamic Core US Fixed Income ETF seeks current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in other U.S. fixed income ETFs. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of borrowing for investment purposes) directly or indirectly in U.S. fixed income securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Astoria Dynamic Core 美國固定收益 ETF 尋求當前收益。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過主要投資於其他美國固定收益 ETF 來實現其投資目標。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上投資目的借款金額）直接或間接投資於美國固定收益證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Finward Bancorp is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It offers checking and savings accounts, loans, eBanking, cash management, investments, retirement plans, and trust funds. The company was founded on January 31, 1994 and is headquartered in Munster, IN.
info.description_zh: Finward Bancorp 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供金融服務。它提供支票和儲蓄帳戶、貸款、電子銀行、現金管理、投資、退休計劃和信託基金。該公司成立於1994年1月31日，總部位於印第安納州蒙斯特。

info.description: First Trust SMID Capital Strength ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the SMID Capital Strength Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select dividend-paying securities issued by mid capitalization U.S. companies.
info.description_zh: First Trust SMID 資本強度 ETF 尋求與稱為 SMID 資本強度指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在選擇中等市值美國公司發行的派息證券。

info.description: SanJac Alpha Core Plus Bond ETF seeks current income and total returns consistent with limited volatility and the preservation of capital. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a portfolio of income-oriented instruments principally consisting of investment-grade U.S. corporate and government debt obligations (including securities issued or guaranteed by the U.S. government or its agencies or instrumentalities), mortgage-backed securities, mortgage real estate investment trusts, and preferred stocks. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SanJac Alpha Core Plus Bond ETF 尋求與有限波動性和資本保存一致的當前收入和總回報。該基金是一隻主動管理的ETF，旨在透過投資收入導向工具投資組合來實現其投資目標，這些工具主要包括投資級美國公司和政府債務債券（包括由美國政府或其機構或工具發行或擔保的證券）、抵押貸款支持證券、抵押房地產投資信託和優先股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Digital Realty Trust, Inc. operates as a real estate investment trust, which engages in the provision of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions. It serves the following industries: artificial intelligence (AI), networks, cloud, digital media, mobile, financial services, healthcare, and gaming. The company was founded on March 9, 2004, and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Digital Realty Trust, Inc. 作為房地產投資信託公司經營，從事提供資料中心、託管和互連解決方案。它服務於以下行業：人工智慧（AI）、網路、雲端、數位媒體、行動、金融服務、醫療保健和遊戲。該公司成立於2004年3月9日，總部位於德州達拉斯。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2032 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2032, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2032 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2032年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人認購選擇權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. engages in the research and development of engineered cells as medicine. It focuses on identifying and developing potential product candidates, executing preclinical studies, and acquiring technology. The company was founded by Steven D. Harr, Noubar B. Afeyan, Robert Taylor Nelsen, and Hans Edgar Bishop on July 2018 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. 從事工程細胞藥物的研究和開發。它專注於識別和開發潛在的候選產品、執行臨床前研究以及獲取技術。該公司由 Steven D. Harr、Noubar B. Afeyan、Robert Taylor Nelsen 和 Hans Edgar Bishop 於 2018 年 7 月創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2031 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2031 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2031. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2031 and December 15, 2031, inclusive. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2031 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤由 2031 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2031 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index 的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足基礎指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由公開發行的美國國債組成，計劃於 2031 年 1 月 1 日至 2031 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。

info.description: SEI DBi Multi-Strategy Alternative ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will take long and short positions in investments that provide broad exposure to the global equity, fixed income and currency markets. The fund will invest primarily in exchange-traded derivative instruments, including futures, options, and swaps, but to a lesser extent may invest in derivative instruments that are traded over-the-counter, such as forwards.
info.description_zh: SEI DBi 多策略另類 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將在提供全球股票、固定收益和貨幣市場廣泛敞口的投資中持有多頭和空頭部位。該基金將主要投資於交易所交易的衍生工具，包括期貨、選擇權和掉期，但也會在較小程度上投資於場外交易的衍生性工具，例如遠期合約。

info.description: The Charles Schwab Corp. is a savings and loan holding company, which engages in the provision of wealth management, securities brokerage, banking, asset management, custody, and financial advisory services. It operates through the Investor Services and Advisor Services segments. The Investor Services segment includes retail brokerage, investment advisory, and banking and trust services to individual investors, retirement plan and business services, as well as other corporate brokerage services, to businesses and employees. The Advisor Services segment provides custodial, trading, banking and trust, and support services to independent registered investment advisors, independent retirement advisors, and recordkeepers. The company was founded by Charles Robert Schwab in 1986 and is headquartered in Westlake, TX.
info.description_zh: 嘉信理財公司是一家儲蓄和貸款控股公司，從事提供財富管理、證券經紀、銀行、資產管理、託管和財務諮詢服務。它透過投資者服務和顧問服務部門運作。投資者服務部門包括為個人投資者提供零售經紀、投資諮詢、銀行和信託服務、退休計畫和商業服務，以及為企業和員工提供的其他企業經紀服務。顧問服務部門為獨立註冊投資顧問、獨立退休顧問和記錄保管員提供託管、交易、銀行和信託以及支援服務。該公司由 Charles Robert Schwab 於 1986 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州西湖。

info.description: Raymond James Financial, Inc. is an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of financial and investment services. Its services include investment management, merger and acquisition and advisory, the underwriting, distribution, trading and brokerage of equity and debt securities, sale of mutual funds, corporate and retail banking, and trust services. It operates through the following segments: Private Client Group, Capital Markets, Asset Management, Bank, and Other. The Private Client Group segment provides financial planning, investment advisory, and securities transaction services to clients through financial advisors. The Capital Markets segment focuses on investment banking, institutional sales, securities trading, equity research and the syndication, and management of investments in low-income housing funds and funds of a similar nature. The Asset Management segment is involved in asset management, portfolio management, and related administrative services to retail and institutional clients. The Bank segment refers to the results of banking operations. The Other segment includes private equity investments, which predominantly consist of investments in third-party funds. The company was founded by Robert A. James in 1962 and is headquartered in St. Petersburg, FL.
info.description_zh: Raymond James Financial, Inc.是一家投資控股公司，從事提供金融和投資服務。其服務包括投資管理、併購和諮詢、股票和債務證券的承銷、分銷、交易和經紀、共同基金銷售、企業和零售銀行業務以及信託服務。它透過以下部門運作：私人客戶部門、資本市場、資產管理、銀行和其他部門。私人客戶集團部門透過財務顧問向客戶提供財務規劃、投資諮詢和證券交易服務。資本市場部門專注於投資銀行、機構銷售、證券交易、股票研究和銀團以及低收入住房基金和類似性質基金的投資管理。資產管理部門為零售和機構客戶提供資產管理、投資組合管理以及相關管理服務。銀行部門是指銀行業務的結果。其他部門包括私募股權投資，主要包括對第三方基金的投資。該公司由 Robert A. James 於 1962 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州聖彼得堡。

info.description: Vera Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnical company which engages in the development and commercialization of transformative treatments for immunological diseases. The company was founded by Marshall Fordyce in May 2016 and is headquartered in Brisbane, CA.
info.description_zh: Vera Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於免疫疾病轉化療法的開發和商業化。該公司由 Marshall Fordyce 於 2016 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州布里斯班。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long RTX Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of RTX. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of RTX, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 RTX 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 RTX 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 RTX 價格每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vistra Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of electricity and power generation. It operates through the following segments: Retail, Texas, East, West, and Asset Closure. The Retail segment includes sale of electricity and natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The Texas and East segments are involved in electricity generation, wholesale energy sales and purchases, commodity risk management activities, fuel production and fuel logistics management. The West segment represents the company's electricity generation operations in CAISO. The Asset Closure segment refers to the decommissioning and reclamation of retired plants and mines. The company was founded in 1882 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 獨立電力生產商
info.description_zh: Vistra Corp.是一家控股公司，從事提供電力和發電業務。該公司透過以下部門營運：零售部門、德州部門、東部部門、西部部門和資產關閉部門。零售部門包括向住宅、商業和工業客戶銷售電力和天然氣。德州和東部部門從事發電、批發能源銷售和採購、商品風險管理活動、燃料生產和燃料物流管理。西部部門代表該公司在 CAISO 的發電業務。資產關閉部分是指退役工廠和礦山的退役和復墾。該公司成立於 1882 年，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: Sagtec Global Ltd. provides IT consulting, software and mobile app development and cloud computing services. It focuses on customizable software solutions encompassing several types of software such as a smart ordering system, Speed +, smart solutions application software for the food and beverage industry. The company was founded on October 31, 2023 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: Sagtec Global Ltd. 提供 IT 諮詢、軟體和行動應用程式開發以及雲端運算服務。它專注於可自訂的軟體解決方案，涵蓋多種類型的軟體，例如智慧訂購系統、Speed +、食品和飲料行業的智慧解決方案應用軟體。該公司成立於2023年10月31日，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: CG Oncology, Inc. is a clinical biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of bladder-sparing therapeutic patients afflicted with bladder cancer. It offers cretostimogene, a product initially in clinical development for the treatment of patients with Non-Muscle Invasive Bladder Cancer (NMIBC). The company was founded by Alex Yeung and Paul A. DeRidder on September 24, 2010 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: CG Oncology, Inc.是一家臨床生物製藥公司，致力於膀胱癌患者膀胱保留治療的開發和商業化。它提供 cretostimogene，這是一種最初處於臨床開發階段的產品，用於治療非肌肉浸潤性膀胱癌 (NMIBC) 患者。該公司由 Alex Yeung 和 Paul A. DeRidder 於 2010 年 9 月 24 日創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST MU ETF is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks Micron Technology, Inc. (MU). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the performance of the underlying leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST MU ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤美光科技 (MU) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 績效的曝險，但須遵守潛在投資收益的上限。

info.description: Synchrony Financial engages in the provision of consumer financial services. It focuses on digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoor, pet, and other industries. The company was founded on September 12, 2003 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Synchrony Financial 從事提供消費金融服務。專注於數位、健康與保健、零售、電信、家居、汽車、戶外、寵物等產業。該公司成立於2003年9月12日，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright Short ETF seeks capital appreciation through short selling securities. Dorsey, Wright & Associates, LLC (the "Sub-Advisor") seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by obtaining short exposure to investment returns of the broad U.S. large-capitalization equity market by engaging in short sales of U.S.-traded equity securities and exchange-traded funds ("ETFs"). Under normal circumstances, it invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in investments that create or result in short exposure to U.S. equity securities.
info.description_zh: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright Short ETF 透過賣空證券尋求資本增值。 Dorsey, Wright & Associates, LLC（「副顧問」）尋求透過賣空美國交易的股票證券和交易所交易基金（「ETF」）來獲得廣泛的美國大盤股市場的投資回報，從而實現基金的投資目標。在正常情況下，其將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於產生或導緻美國股本證券空頭敞口的投資。

info.description: First Trust Nasdaq BuyWrite Income ETF seeks to provide current income. The fund will pursue its investment objective by investing primarily in equity securities listed on U.S. exchanges and by utilizing an "option strategy" consisting of writing (selling) U.S. exchange-traded call options on the Nasdaq-100 Index. The call options written by the fund will have expirations of less than one year, and will be typically written at-the-money to out-of-the-money.
info.description_zh: First Trust Nasdaq BuyWrite Income ETF 尋求提供當前收入。該基金將透過主要投資於美國交易所上市的股票證券並利用「選擇權策略」來實現其投資目標，其中包括賣出（出售）納斯達克 100 指數的美國交易所交易看漲期權。該基金所簽發的買權的到期日將少於一年，並且通常會以平價或價外形式出售。

info.description: Hyperion DeFi, Inc. is a long-term strategic treasury of Hyperliquid's native token HYPE. The firm provides investors with streamlined access to the Hyperliquid ecosystem and is also developing its proprietary Optejet user-filled device, designed for use with a variety of topical ophthalmic liquids, including artificial tears and lens rewetting products. It operates through the following segments: Ophthalmic Technology and Digital Assets. The Ophthalmic Technology segment focuses on developing eye-care devices and delivery systems for ophthalmic liquids. The Digital Assets segment focuses on managing a strategic treasury of blockchain-based assets and exposure to the Hyperliquid ecosystem. The company was founded by Sean Ianchulev on March 12, 2014 and is headquartered in Laguna Hills, CA.
info.description_zh: Hyperion DeFi, Inc. 是 Hyperliquid 原生代幣 HYPE 的長期策略金庫。該公司為投資者提供了進入 Hyperliquid 生態系統的簡化途徑，並且還在開發其專有的 Optejet 用戶填充設備，該設備設計用於各種局部眼科液體，包括人工淚液和鏡片再潤濕產品。它透過以下部門運作：眼科技術部門和數位資產部門。眼科技術部門專注於開發眼科護理設備和眼科液體輸送系統。數位資產部門專注於管理基於區塊鏈的資產的策略金庫以及對 Hyperliquid 生態系統的投資。該公司由 Sean Ianchulev 於 2014 年 3 月 12 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州拉古納山。

info.description: Liberty One Spectrum ETF seeks capital appreciation and to provide current income. The fund will be invested primarily in the equity securities of large-capitalization companies that have a strong track record of paying a rising dividend to shareholders and that the Adviser considers to be established and mature, market leaders, with a strong, stable financial foundation and that have the potential for reduced volatility and high liquidity.
info.description_zh: Liberty One Spectrum ETF 尋求資本增值並提供當前收入。該基金將主要投資於大型公司的股本證券，這些公司在向股東支付不斷增加的股息方面擁有良好的記錄，並且顧問認為這些公司是成熟且成熟的市場領導者，具有強大、穩定的財務基礎，並且具有減少波動性和高流動性的潛力。

info.description: WisdomTree Target Range Fund seeks to provide capital appreciation, with a secondary objective of hedging risk. In pursuing its investment objectives, the fund adviser seeks to follow the methodology of the TOPS Global Equity Target RangeTM Index. However, the fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). Under normal conditions, approximately 80-85% of the fund's assets are expected to be invested in the cash collateral component upon the annual roll date in January. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree Target Range 基金旨在提供資本增值，次要目標是對沖風險。在追求投資目標時，基金顧問力求遵循 TOPS 全球股票目標範圍™ 指數的方法。然而，該基金是主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」）。在正常情況下，大約 80-85% 的基金資產預計將在一月份的年度展期日投資於現金抵押品部分。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Intel Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of computer products and technologies. It delivers computer, networking, data storage, and communications platforms. The firm operates through the following segments: Client Computing Group (CCG), Data Center and AI (DCAI), Intel Foundry Services (IFS), and All Other. The CCG segment consists of platforms designed for notebooks, 2-in-1 systems, desktops, tablets, phones, wireless and wired connectivity products, and mobile communication components. The DCAI segment delivers solutions to cloud service providers and enterprise customers, along with silicon devices for communications service providers and high-performance computing customers. The IFS segment refers to full stack solutions created from the foundry industry ecosystem. The All Other segment represents results from other non-reportable segments and corporate-related charges. The company was founded by Robert Norton Noyce and Gordon Earle Moore on July 18, 1968, and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: 英特爾公司從事電腦產品和技術的設計、製造和銷售。它提供電腦、網路、資料儲存和通訊平台。該公司透過以下部門運作：客戶端計算部門 (CCG)、資料中心和人工智慧 (DCAI)、英特爾代工服務 (IFS) 和所有其他部門。 CCG 部門包括專為筆記型電腦、二合一系統、桌上型電腦、平板電腦、手機、無線和有線連接產品以及行動通訊組件設計的平台。 DCAI部門為雲端服務供應商和企業客戶提供解決方案，並為通訊服務供應商和高效能運算客戶提供矽設備。 IFS 部分是指從代工產業生態系統創建的全端解決方案。所有其他部門代表其他非報告部門的績效和公司相關費用。該公司由羅伯特·諾頓·諾伊斯 (Robert Norton Noyce) 和戈登·厄爾·摩爾 (Gordon Earle Moore) 於 1968 年 7 月 18 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖克拉拉。

info.description: GE Vernova, Inc. engages in the electric power industry. It operates through the following segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment offers design, manufacture, and servicing gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies, providing a critical foundation of dispatchable, flexible, stable, and reliable power. The Wind segment manages wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment refers to the grid solutions, power conversion, electrification software, and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was founded November 9, 2021 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: GE Vernova, Inc. 從事電力業。它透過以下部門運作：電力、風能和電氣化。電力部門提供設計、製造和維修天然氣、核能、水力和蒸汽技術，為可調度、靈活、穩定和可靠的電力提供關鍵基礎。風能部門管理風力發電技術，包括陸上和離岸風力渦輪機和葉片。電氣化部分是指從發電點到用電點的電力傳輸、分配、轉換、儲存和編排所需的電網解決方案、電力轉換、電氣化軟體以及太陽能和儲存解決方案技術。該公司成立於 2021 年 11 月 9 日，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: WisdomTree India Hedged Equity Fund ETF seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the WisdomTree India Hedged Equity Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in the constituent securities of its index. WisdomTree, the index provider and parent company of WisdomTree Asset Management, Inc. has created the index to provide exposure to companies incorporated, listed, and traded in India, while at the same time "hedging" or neutralizing exposure to fluctuations in the value of the Indian rupee relative to the U.S. dollar. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 印度對沖股票基金 ETF 旨在追蹤 WisdomTree 印度對沖股票指數（未計費用和開支）的價格和收益率表現。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於其指數的成分證券。 WisdomTree 是 WisdomTree Asset Management, Inc. 的指數提供者和母公司，而創建該指數的目的是為在印度註冊、上市和交易的公司提供風險敞口，同時「對沖」或抵消印度盧比相對於美元價值波動的風險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco DWA Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Technical Leaders Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of approximately 100 securities from an eligible universe of approximately 1,000 securities of the largest constituents by market capitalization within the NASDAQ US Benchmark Index.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Technical Leaders Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the 10% 只证券组成，这些证券来自纳斯达克美国基准指数中市值最大的成分股的约 1,000 只合格证券。

info.description: Sound Financial Bancorp, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of traditional banking and other financial services. It involves attracting retail and commercial deposits from the general public and local governments and investing those funds, along with borrowed funds, in loans secured by first and second mortgages on one- to four-family residences, commercial and multifamily real estate, construction and land, consumer, and commercial business loans. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Sound Financial Bancorp, Inc. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供傳統銀行和其他金融服務。它涉及吸引公眾和地方政府的零售和商業存款，並將這些資金與借入的資金一起投資於一到四戶住宅、商業和多戶房地產、建築和土地、消費者和商業企業貸款的第一和第二抵押貸款。該公司成立於 2008 年，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Tema Electrification ETF seeks to provide long-term growth of capital. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets, which include borrowings for investment purposes, common and preferred stocks of publicly listed companies that are directly or indirectly economically tied to global electrification. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tema Electrification ETF 致力於提供長期的資本成長。在正常情況下，該基金尋求透過投資至少80%的淨資產來實現其投資目標，其中包括用於投資目的的借款、與全球電氣化經濟直接或間接相關的上市公司的普通股和優先股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: AMETEK, Inc. engages in the manufacture of electronic instruments and electromechanical devices. It operates through the following segments: Electronic Instruments (EIG), Electromechanical (EMG), and Corporate. The EIG segment focuses on the design and manufacture of analytical, test, and measurement instruments for the process, aerospace, medical, research, power, and industrial markets. The EMG segment is involved in the design and manufacture of medical components and devices, automation solutions, thermal management systems, specialty metals, and electrical interconnects. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Berwyn, PA.
info.description_zh: AMETEK, Inc. 從事電子儀器和機電設備的製造。它透過以下部門運作：電子儀器部門 (EIG)、機電部門 (EMG) 和企業部門。 EIG 部門專注於為製程、航空航太、醫療、研究、電力和工業市場設計和製造分析、測試和測量儀器。 EMG 部門涉及醫療組件和設備、自動化解決方案、熱管理系統、特殊金屬和電氣互連的設計和製造。該公司成立於 1930 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州伯文。

info.description: SGI Enhanced Global Income ETF seeks income. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") and seeks to achieve its objective by (1) actively investing in global companies that offer dividend income and that trade on U.S. stock exchanges and (2) investing in options strategies that seek to generate current income. The fund uses an actively traded put and call options strategy that choose deep out-of-the-money strike prices generally expiring within 1-7 days to generate income.
info.description_zh: SGI 增強型全球收益 ETF 尋求收益。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過（1）積極投資於提供股息收入並在美國證券交易所交易的全球公司以及（2）投資於尋求產生當前收入的選擇策略來實現其目標。該基金採用交易活躍的看跌期權和看漲期權策略，選擇通常在 1-7 天內到期的深度價外執行價格來產生收入。

info.description: Pool Corp. engages in the wholesale distribution of swimming pool supplies, equipment, and related leisure products. It also offers non-discretionary pool maintenance products such as chemicals and replacement parts, discretionary products like packaged pool kits, whole goods, irrigation, and landscape products, including a complete line of commercial and residential irrigation products and parts, power equipment for the professional landscape market, specialty products such as outdoor lighting, grills, and outdoor kitchen components, and golf irrigation and water management products. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Covington, LA.
info.description_zh: Pool Corp. 從事游泳池用品、設備和相關休閒產品的批發分銷。它還提供非全權泳池維護產品，如化學品和替換零件，全權產品，如包裝泳池套件、整體商品、灌溉和景觀產品，包括全系列商業和住宅灌溉產品和零件，專業景觀市場的電力設備，戶外照明、烤架和戶外廚房組件等特色產品，以及高爾夫灌溉和水管理產品。該公司成立於 1993 年，總部位於路易斯安那州卡溫頓。

info.description: Ebang International Holdings, Inc. is a blockchain technology company, which engages in the research and development of ASIC chip technology used in blockchain applications in China. It also manufactures bitcoin mining machines. The company was founded by Dong Hu in January 2010 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 億邦國際控股有限公司是一家區塊鏈技術公司，在中國從事區塊鏈應用ASIC晶片技術的研發。它还生产比特币采矿机。該公司由胡東於2010年1月創立，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: SPDR Galaxy Digital Asset Ecosystem ETF seeks to provide long term capital appreciation. The Sub-Adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing, directly or indirectly, in (i) equity securities of foreign and domestic companies within the crypto asset and blockchain industries, (ii) exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that primarily hold bitcoin and/or ether futures contracts ("Crypto Asset Futures ETFs"), (iii) bitcoin and ether futures contracts ("crypto asset futures"), and (iv) exchange-traded products that hold bitcoin or ether as a reference asset ("Spot Crypto Asset ETPs"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR Galaxy 數位資產生態系統 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。副顧問尋求透過直接或間接投資於（i）加密資產和區塊鏈產業內的外國和國內公司的股本證券，（ii）主要持有比特幣和/或以太坊期貨合約（「加密資產期貨ETF」）的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），（iii）比特幣和以太坊期貨交易（iv幣貨幣參考資產（「現貨加密資產 ETP」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EAFE ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EAFE Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of large- and mid-capitalization developed market equities, excluding the U.S. and Canada that have positive environmental, social and governance characteristics as identified by the index provider while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the parent index.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EAFE ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI EAFE 擴展 ESG 焦點指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。基礎指數由大中型已開發市場股票組成，不包括美國和加拿大，這些股票具有指數提供者確定的積極的環境、社會和治理特徵，同時表現出與母指數相似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: Pacer ActiveAlpha India Quality ETF is a concentrated equity strategy providing targeted exposure to Indian companies, specifically designed to capture the structural growth of the Indian economy through a rigorous, rules-based selection process. The fund employs a proprietary factor-based methodology that identifies and holds a limited portfolio of approximately 20 to 30 companies deemed to be of high quality, while simultaneously applying screens for value and momentum to optimize the risk-return profile.
info.description_zh: Pacer ActiveAlpha India Quality ETF 是一項集中式股票策略，為印度公司提供有針對性的投資，專門旨在透過嚴格的、基於規則的選擇流程來捕捉印度經濟的結構性成長。該基金採用專有的基於因素的方法，識別並持有約 20 至 30 家被視為高品質公司的有限投資組合，同時應用價值和動量篩選以優化風險回報狀況。

info.description: Trane Technologies Plc engages in providing solutions to buildings, homes, and transportation. It operates through the following business segments: Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific. The Americas segment encompasses commercial heating and cooling systems, building controls, and energy services and solutions, residential heating and cooling, and transport refrigeration systems, and solutions in North America and Latin America regions. The EMEA segment includes heating and cooling systems, services and solutions for commercial buildings, and transport refrigeration systems and solutions in Europe, Middle East, and Africa regions. The Asia Pacific segment is involved in heating and cooling systems, services and solutions for commercial buildings and transport refrigeration systems and solutions in Asia Pacific region. The company was founded in 1871 and is headquartered in Swords, Ireland.
info.description_zh: 特靈科技有限公司致力於為建築、住宅和交通提供解決方案。它透過以下業務部門運作：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲和亞太地區。美洲部門包括商業供暖和製冷系統、樓宇控制、能源服務和解決方案、住宅供暖和製冷、運輸冷卻系統以及北美和拉丁美洲地區的解決方案。歐洲、中東和非洲地區包括商業建築的暖氣和冷氣系統、服務和解決方案，以及歐洲、中東和非洲地區的運輸冷卻系統和解決方案。亞太地區業務涉及亞太地區商業建築的供暖和製冷系統、服務和解決方案以及運輸冷卻系統和解決方案。該公司成立於 1871 年，總部位於愛爾蘭索茲。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long VST ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Vistra Corp. (NYSE: VST). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long VST ETF 尋求 Vistra Corp.（NYSE：VST）每日股價變動百分比兩倍（200%）的每日槓桿投資結果。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Covered Call ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, generally to the price and yield performance of the CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite V2 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite Index is a benchmark index that measures the performance of a theoretical portfolio that holds a portfolio of the stocks included in the NASDAQ-100 Index, and "writes" (or sells) a succession of one-month at-the-money NASDAQ-100 Index covered call options. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 備兌買權 ETF 尋求提供與 CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite V2 指數（「基本指數」）的價格和收益率表現密切對應的投資結果（未計費和支出）。該基金將至少80%的總資產投資於相關指數的證券。 CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite 指數是衡量理論投資組合表現的基準指數，該理論投資組合持有 NASDAQ-100 指數中包含的股票投資組合，並「賣出」（或賣出）一系列 1 個月平價 NASDAQ-100 指數擔保看漲期權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Canton Strategic Holdings, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a portfolio of therapeutic candidates for inflammation and immunology. It also develops TH104, which is known to suppress chronic, debilitating pruritus or uncontrollable itching in PBC, a rare and orphan liver disease with no known cure. The company was founded on March 28, 2017 and is headquartered in Bridgewater, NJ.
info.description_zh: Canton Strategy Holdings, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，開發發炎和免疫學候選治療藥物組合。它還開發了 TH104，已知它可以抑制 PBC 中的慢性、衰弱性瘙癢或無法控制的瘙癢，PBC 是一種罕見的孤兒肝病，目前尚無已知的治癒方法。該公司成立於2017年3月28日，總部位於新澤西州布里奇沃特。

info.description: Winchester Bancorp, Inc. operates as an investment holding company of Winchester Savings Bank which engages in providing banking services. Its personal banking products and services include deposits, such as Nexus and Nexus Plus, checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, and individual retirement accounts, loans, including mortgage, home equity, and consumer loans, and services, such as convenience services, Internet and mobile banking, insurance products, and other services. The company was founded on March 3, 1871 and is headquartered in Winchester, MA.
info.description_zh: Winchester Bancorp, Inc. 是 Winchester Savings Bank 的投資控股公司，提供銀行服務。其個人銀行產品和服務包括存款（例如 Nexus 和 Nexus Plus）、支票、儲蓄、貨幣市場、存款證和個人退休帳戶、貸款（包括抵押貸款、房屋淨值和消費貸款）以及服務（例如便利服務、網路和行動銀行、保險產品和其他服務）。該公司成立於 1871 年 3 月 3 日，總部位於馬薩諸塞州溫徹斯特。

info.description: VanEck Gaming ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS Global Gaming Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. To be initially eligible for the index, companies must generate at least 50% of their revenues from gaming. Gaming includes casinos and casino hotels, sports betting (including internet gambling and racetracks) and lottery services as well as gaming services, gaming technology and gaming equipment. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Gaming ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製未計費用和支出之前的 MVIS 全球博彩指數的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。為了最初符合該指數的資格，公司必須至少 50% 的收入來自遊戲。博彩包括賭場和賭場酒店、體育博彩（包括網路博彩和賽馬場）和彩票服務以及博彩服務、博彩技術和博彩設備。它是非多元化的。

info.description: CRH Plc manufactures and distributes building materials and products for the construction industry. It operates business through the following segments: Americas Materials Solutions, Americas Building Solutions, Europe Materials Solutions, and Europe Building Solutions. The Americas Materials Solutions segment provides solutions for the construction and maintenance of public infrastructure and commercial and residential buildings in North America. The Americas Building Solutions segment manufactures, supplies and delivers solutions for the built environment in communities across North America. The Europe Materials Solutions segment provides solutions for the construction of public infrastructure and commercial and residential buildings to customers in construction markets in Europe. The Europe Building Solutions segment combines materials, products and services to produce a wide range of architectural and infrastructural solutions for use in the building and renovation of critical utility infrastructure, commercial and residential buildings, and outdoor living spaces. CRH was founded on June 20, 1949 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: CRH Plc 為建築業生產和銷售建築材料和產品。該公司透過以下部門開展業務：美洲材料解決方案部門、美洲建築解決方案部門、歐洲材料解決方案部門和歐洲建築解決方案部門。美洲材料解決方案部門為北美公共基礎設施以及商業和住宅建築的建設和維護提供解決方案。美洲建築解決方案部門為北美社區的建築環境製造、供應和提供解決方案。歐洲材料解決方案部門為歐洲建築市場的客戶提供公共基礎設施以及商業和住宅建築建設的解決方案。歐洲建築解決方案部門將材料、產品和服務結合起來，生產廣泛的建築和基礎設施解決方案，用於關鍵公用設施基礎設施、商業和住宅建築以及戶外生活空間的建設和改造。 CRH成立於1949年6月20日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: iShares MSCI Turkey ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Turkey IMI 25/50 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of the large-, mid- and small-capitalization segments of equity market in Turkey. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 土耳其 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 土耳其 IMI 25/50 指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數旨在衡量土耳其股票市場大、中、小型股的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSLA ETF seeks current income; the secondary investment objective being exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated securities exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage of the common stock of Tesla Inc. subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the underlying TSLA ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSLA ETF 尋求當前收益；次要投資目標是接觸一隻或多只交易所交易基金的業績，這些基金的股票在美國監管的證券交易所進行交易，並尋求每日槓桿投資結果為特斯拉公司普通股每日百分比的 2 倍 (200%)，但受到潛在投資收益的限制。該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於以標的TSLA ETF作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Airbnb, Inc. engages in the management and operation of an online marketplace. Its marketplace model connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces. The company was founded by Brian Chesky, Nathan Blecharczyk and Joseph Gebbia in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Airbnb, Inc. 從事線上市場的管理和營運。其市場模式將主人和客人在線上或透過行動裝置連接起來預訂空間。該公司由 Brian Chesky、Nathan Blecharczyk 和 Joseph Gebbia 於 2007 年創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: HCA Healthcare, Inc. is a health care services company, which engages in operating hospitals, freestanding surgery centers and emergency care facilities, urgent care facilities, walk-in clinics, diagnostic and imaging centers, radiation and oncology therapy centers, comprehensive rehabilitation and physical therapy centers, physician practices, home health, hospice, outpatient physical therapy home and community-based services providers, and various other facilities. The firm operates general and acute care hospitals that offer medical and surgical services, including inpatient care, intensive care, cardiac care, diagnostic, and emergency services, and outpatient services, such as outpatient surgery, laboratory, radiology, respiratory therapy, cardiology, and physical therapy. The company was founded by Dr. Thomas F. Frist, Jr in 1968 and is headquartered in Nashville, TN.
info.description_zh: HCA Healthcare, Inc. 是一家醫療保健服務公司，從事營運醫院、獨立手術中心和緊急護理設施、緊急護理設施、步入式診所、診斷和成像中心、放射和腫瘤治療中心、綜合復健和物理治療中心、醫生診所、家庭保健、臨終關懷、門診物理治療家庭和社區服務提供者以及各種其他設施。該公司經營普通和急診醫院，提供醫療和外科服務，包括住院護理、重症監護、心臟護理、診斷和緊急服務，以及門診服務，如門診手術、實驗室、放射科、呼吸治療、心臟病學和物理治療。該公司由 Thomas F. Frist, Jr 博士於 1968 年創立，總部位於田納西州納許維爾。

info.description: TuHURA Biosciences, Inc. is a clinical-stage immuno-oncology company, which engages in the development of novel technologies to overcome resistance to cancer immunotherapy. Its lead product candidate, IFx2.0, is an innate immune agonist designed to overcome primary resistance to checkpoint inhibitors. The company was founded by Michael Lawman, Patricia Lawman and James A. Bianco on May 4, 2023 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.description_zh: TuHURA Biosciences, Inc.是一家臨床階段的免疫腫瘤學公司，致力於開發克服癌症免疫療法抗藥性的新技術。其主要候選產品 IFx2.0 是一種先天免疫激動劑，旨在克服對檢查點抑制劑的主要抗藥性。該公司由 Michael Lawman、Patricia Lawman 和 James A. Bianco 於 2023 年 5 月 4 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: WisdomTree Japan Hedged SmallCap Equity Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the WisdomTree Japan Hedged SmallCap Equity Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in component securities of the index and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of such component securities. The index is a dividend weighted index designed to provide exposure to Japanese equity markets while at the same time neutralizing exposure to fluctuations of the value of the Japanese yen relative to the U.S. dollar. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 日本對沖小型股股票基金旨在追蹤 WisdomTree 日本對沖小型股股票指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於指數的組成證券以及具有與此類組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是股息加權指數，旨在提供對日本股市的曝險，同時抵消日圓相對美元價值波動的曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cummins, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and distribution of diesel, natural gas, electric and hybrid powertrains and powertrain-related components including filtration, aftertreatment, turbochargers, fuel systems, valvetrain technologies, controls systems, air handling systems, automated transmissions, axles, drivelines, brakes, suspension systems, electric power generation systems, batteries, electrified power systems, hydrogen production technologies, and fuel cell products. It operates through the following segments: Engine, Distribution, Components, Power Systems, and Accelera. The Engine segment manufactures and markets diesel and natural gas-powered engines under the Cummins brand name, for the heavy- and medium-duty truck, bus, recreational vehicle, light-duty automotive, construction, mining, marine, rail, oil and gas, defense, and agricultural markets. The Distribution segment includes power generation systems, high-horsepower engines, heavy-duty and medium-duty engines designed for on- and off-highway use, application engineering services, custom-designed assemblies, retail and wholesale aftermarket parts, and in-shop and field-based repair service. The Components segment supplies products including axles, drivelines, brakes and suspension systems for commercial diesel and natural gas applications, aftertreatment systems, turbochargers, fuel systems, valvetrain technologies, filtration products, automated transmissions, and electronics. The Power Systems segment engages in power generation, industrial, and generator technologies. The Accelera segment designs, manufactures, sells, and supports hydrogen production technologies, as well as electrified power systems, including battery, fuel cell, and electric powertrain technologies. The company was founded by Clessie Lyle Cummins and William Glanton Irwin on February 3, 1919 and is headquartered in Columbus, IN.
info.description_zh: 康明斯公司從事柴油、天然氣、電動和混合動力系統以及動力系統相關組件的設計、製造和分銷，包括過濾、後處​​理、渦輪增壓器、燃油系統、氣門系統技術、控制系統、空氣處理系統、自動變速箱、車軸、傳動系統、制動器、懸吊系統、發電系統、電池、電氣化電力系統、制氫技術和燃料電池產品。它透過以下部門運作：引擎部門、分銷部門、零件部門、電力系統部門和 Accelera 部門。發動機部門以康明斯品牌製造和銷售柴油和天然氣動力發動機，適用於重型和中型卡車、巴士、休閒車、輕型汽車、建築、採礦、船舶、鐵路、石油和天然氣、國防和農業市場。分銷部門包括發電系統、大馬力發動機、專為公路和非公路使用而設計的重型和中型發動機、應用工程服務、定制設計組件、零售和批發售後零件以及店內和現場維修服務。零件部門提供的產品包括用於商業柴油和天然氣應用的車軸、傳動系統、煞車和懸吊系統、後處理系統、渦輪增壓器、燃油系統、氣門機構技術、過濾產品、自動變速箱和電子產品。電力系統部門從事發電、工業和發電機技術。 Accelera 部門設計、製造、銷售和支援氫氣生產技術以及電氣化電力系統，包括電池、燃料電池和電動動力總成技術。該公司由 Clessie Lyle Cummins 和 William Glanton Irwin 於 1919 年 2 月 3 日創立，總部位於印第安納州哥倫布。

info.description: Intellia Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of curative therapeutics using the CRISPR/Cas9 system. Its CRISPR/Cas9 system transforms medicine by both producing therapeutics that permanently edit and/or correct disease-associated genes in the human body with a single treatment course and creates engineered cells that can treat oncological and immunological diseases. The company was founded by Andrew May, Luciano Marraffini, Rodolphe Barrangou, Nessan Bermingham, Rachel Haurwitz, Erik Sontheimer, Jennifer Doudna and Derrick Rossi in May 2014 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.

info.description: Generate Biomedicines, Inc. is a clinical-stage generative biology company pioneering the AI revolution in biotechnology and drug design and development. The company was founded in 2018, and is headquartered in Somerville, MA.
info.description_zh: Generate Biomedicines, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生成生物學公司，引領生物技術和藥物設計與開發領域的人工智慧革命。該公司成立於 2018 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州薩默維爾。

info.description: Global X Nasdaq 100 Covered Call & Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Cboe Nasdaq 100 Half BuyWrite V2 Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of a theoretical portfolio that holds a portfolio of the stocks included in the NASDAQ 100 Index (the "reference index"), and "writes" (or sells) a succession of one-month at-the-money covered call options on the reference index. It generally will use a replication strategy. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X Nasdaq 100 Covered Call & Growth ETF 力求提供與 Cboe Nasdaq 100 Half BuyWrite V2 指數（「基本指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。基礎指數衡量理論投資組合的表現，該理論投資組合持有納斯達克 100 指數（「參考指數」）中包含的股票投資組合，並「賣出」（或出售）參考指數的一系列一個月期平值備兌買權。它通常會使用複製策略。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Ardelyx, Inc. is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of innovative medicines that meet significant unmet medical needs. Its products include IBSRELA and XPHOZAH. The company was founded by Dominique Charmot, Peter G. Schultz, and Jean M. Frechet in October 2007 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Ardelyx, Inc. 是一家商業階段的生物製藥公司，專注於創新藥物的開發和商業化，以滿足重大未滿足的醫療需求。其產品包括IBSRELA和XPHOZAH。該公司由 Dominique Charmot、Peter G. Schultz 和 Jean M. Frechet 於 2007 年 10 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: iShares Core MSCI Total International Stock ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI ACWI ex USA IMI composed of large-, mid- and small-capitalization non-U.S. equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization index designed to measure the combined equity market performance of developed and emerging markets countries, excluding the United States.
info.description_zh: iShares Core MSCI Total International Stock ETF 旨在追蹤由大、中、小型非美國股票組成的 MSCI ACWI ex USA IMI 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值指數，旨在衡量已開發市場和新興市場國家（不包括美國）的綜合股市表現。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long INTC Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Intel Corp. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long INTC Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果為英特爾公司普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Remitly Global, Inc. engages in the provision of digital financial services for immigrants and their families. The company was founded by Matthew B. Oppenheimer and Joshua Hug on October 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Remitly Global, Inc. 致力於為移民及其家人提供數位金融服務。該公司由 Matthew B. Oppenheimer 和 Joshua Hug 於 2018 年 10 月 3 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: NestYield Visionary ETF seeks long-term growth; the fund's secondary investment objective is to seek current income. The fund's strategy involves two components: (1) purchasing a portfolio of equity securities either directly, or "synthetically" by using options to gain exposure to one or more equity securities; and (2) generating income through an options portfolio. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: NestYield Visionary ETF尋求長期成長；該基金的次要投資目標是尋求當前收入。本基金的策略涉及兩個組成部分：(1) 直接購買股權證券投資組合，或透過使用選擇權「綜合」購買一種或多種股權證券； (2) 透過選擇權投資組合產生收入。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily INTC Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of INTC. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of INTC and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to INTC, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily INTC Bull 2X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 INTC 每日業績的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 INTC 的證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 INTC 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與該基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Militia Long/Short Equity ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in both long and short positions in equity securities or ETFs that Militia Investments, LLC, the sub-adviser to the fund (the "Sub-Adviser"), believes offer the potential for capital appreciation. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Militia 多頭/空頭股票 ETF 尋求資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資股票證券或 ETF 的多頭和空頭部位來實現其投資目標，該基金的副顧問（「副顧問」）Militia Investments, LLC 認為這些證券或 ETF 具有資本增值的潛力。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Energy Storage & Materials ETF seeks to track the investment results of STOXX Global Energy Storage and Materials Index. The index measures the performance of equity securities of companies involved in energy storage solutions aiming to support the transition to a low carbon economy, including hydrogen, fuel cells, and batteries as determined by STOXX Ltd. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 儲能和材料 ETF 旨在追蹤 STOXX 全球儲能和材料指數的投資結果。該指數衡量參與能源儲存解決方案的公司的股本證券的表現，這些解決方案旨在支持向低碳經濟轉型，包括由 STOXX Ltd 確定的氫、燃料電池和電池。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其基礎指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Yum! Brands, Inc. is a service restaurant company, which engages in the development, operation, franchise, and licenses of a system of restaurants. It operates through the following segments: KFC Division, Pizza Hut Division, Taco Bell Division, and Habit Burger Grill Division. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Louisville, KY.
info.description_zh: 嗯！ Brands, Inc. 是一家服務餐廳公司，從事餐廳系統的開發、營運、特許經營和許可業務。它透過以下部門運作：肯德基部門、必勝客部門、塔可鐘部門和Habit Burger Grill部門。該公司成立於 1997 年，總部位於肯塔基州路易斯維爾。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long GEV Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of GEV. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of GEV, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2X Long GEV Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common und of GEV. info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long BE Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of BE. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of BE, consistent with the fund's investment objective.
